subject: Creature row health fallback and conditioned placement respawn contract deployed
scope: Runtime correction for creatures without creature_stat and for mission-conditioned creature placement refresh. No world rows or game balance values were changed.

findings.field: creature health when creature_stat is absent
findings.source: src/Rasa.Game/Managers/CreatureManager.cs CreateFromTemplate, creature.max_hp in live rasaworld.db; original live image used hardcoded 100 HP in the no-stat branch
findings.observation: Of 922 live creature templates, 769 lack creature_stat; all 769 have max_hp between 500 and 1500. Boot-camp Thrax template 198507 has max_hp 555 and no stat row. Hardcoded 100 ignored the only health field available for those rows.
findings.implementation: Use creature.MaxHitPoints, capped at Int32.MaxValue, as the health fallback. Explicit creature_stat.health continues to take precedence.
findings.fidelity_limit: The seeded max_hp values are emulator data; this corrects their application, not their unverified final-live magnitudes. Many boot-camp max_hp values are labelled analogues in docs/evidence/bootcamp-d11-reconstruction-manifest.json.

findings.observation: A mission-state refresh could recreate a killed conditioned placement after its corpse was removed, even with respawn_ms 0 or before its timed respawn was due.
findings.implementation: Record zero-respawn kills for the lifetime of the map channel; prevent condition refresh while that record or a timed respawn entry exists. A new private channel starts fresh.
findings.fidelity_limit: Exact final-live ally and boss respawn rules remain unknown. This enforces the seeded placement's explicit respawn_ms contract.

verification.build: Derived from the immediately preceding live game image, overlaying only three source files with the health fallback and respawn contract. dotnet build --no-restore succeeded with three existing warnings and zero errors.
verification.tests: Focused .NET 5 ContentPlacementRespawnTests and AllyFinishingTheFlagBossCreditsThePrivateMapOwnerBeforeOneShotDespawn passed 3/3 in the worktree. The health fallback is additionally evidenced by earlier copied-client combat traces with the worktree implementation; no new live in-world combat was run after deployment.
verification.deployment: SQLite backup API copies of auth, char and world passed integrity_check. Tagged old image, moved the candidate to latest, recreated only game with docker compose up --no-build -d game. At 00:46:33 UTC game loaded 17 content rules/404 rows/0 gaps, opened its world listener and authenticated with Auth. Auth and Game stayed running with zero restarts; all three live databases passed integrity_check.
verification.client: Recovered 1.16.5.0 client logged in through VPS Tailscale 100.104.53.1:2116 with the public test account, sent Login, ServerListExt and AboutToPlay, and displayed Character Select. The owner MacBook and in-world HP presentation were not checked after this deployment.

remaining: A copied original-client replay after deployment entered a private boot-camp instance, approached the courtyard and fired, then died during inspection pauses before reaching the cave; see docs/evidence/bootcamp-after-health-client-replay.json. It did not measure internal creature HP or complete a normal fight. Health magnitudes, actor activation/target selection and original respawn behavior still require stronger final-live evidence.
